marketing_description: The Milwaukee 2834-21HD M18 FUEL Series Circular Saw Kit features a 7-1/4 in blade diameter and 2-1/2 in cutting depth, with a 53 deg cutting angle and 5/8 in arbor size. Powered by an 18 V REDLITHIUM FORGE Battery, it operates at 5800 RPM. The kit includes a magnesium shoe and guards, integrated LED light, electric blade brake, and rafter hook.
